basic_details.scholarship_name: Italian Regional DSU / EDISU Merit & Need Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Regional Governments of Italy (DSU Toscana, EDISU Piemonte, LazioDisco, ER.GO Emilia-Romagna, ESU Padova, ALiSEO Liguria)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All Italian Public Universities (Politecnico di Milano, Politecnico di Torino, University of Bologna, Sapienza University of Rome, University of Florence, University of Pisa, University of Padua, University of Milan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to ALL fields of study without restriction (Engineering, Architecture, Design, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Medicine, Economics, Business, Humanities, Natural Sciences).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Tens of thousands of regional grants awarded across all Italian universities annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Entitlement-based quota: Hundreds of Pakistani students qualify every year if their family income meets financial eligibility thresholds
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Bachelor's: 3 years; Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 years (renewed annually subject to credit requirements)

nationality_requirements: Open to all international students admitted to an Italian public university (Pakistani students fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 12 years education (HSSC/A-Levels) for Bachelor's; 16 years education (BS/Master's) for Master's; 18 years education for PhD from HEC recognized universities.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: No minimum GPA required for 1st-year entry scholarship; based primarily on admission to the university and family income (ISEE Parificato).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Admission into any accredited degree course at an Italian public university.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Enrolled or accepted into an Italian university.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS 6.0 or university-approved English proficiency (many Italian universities accept English Medium of Instruction certificates from Pakistani universities for admission).
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None for English-taught programs; Italian B2 for Italian-taught courses.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: CORE FINANCIAL ELIGIBILITY: Equivalent Economic Situation Indicator (ISEE Parificato) must be BELOW the regional threshold (typically €24,000 to €27,000/year). Given Pakistani currency exchange rates, the vast majority of Pakistani middle-class families fall well below this ceiling and qualify easily.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Students cannot hold duplicate regional or government scholarships in Italy.

tuition_fee.details: 100% university tuition fee waiver; students pay only the statutory regional tax (€140 to €160/year).

admission_application_fee.details: University pre-admission evaluation fee (€30 to €50) paid by applicant to university.

accommodation.details: Free student accommodation in university residence halls OR a housing grant allowance (typically €2,500 to €3,500/year) if placed on the housing waitlist.

monthly_stipend.details: Annual cash maintenance stipend paid in two installments (December and June).
monthly_stipend.amount: €2,500 to €6,500 / year (depending on 'non-resident / out-of-town' student status) (~PKR 750,000 to 1,950,000 / year)

airfare.details: International air travel between Pakistan and Italy is NOT covered (borne by student).

visa_fee.details: Italian National D Student Visa fee (~€50 / PKR 16,000) paid at Gerry's / Italian Embassy in Pakistan.

health_insurance.details: Students register with Italian National Health Service (SSN) paying subsidized student fee (€150 to €700/year) for comprehensive medical coverage.

food_allowance.details: One free meal per day at university cafeterias (Mensa universitaria) for the entire academic year.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Discounted local public transportation pass available to students.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single University: DSU/EDISU application is submitted to the regional agency governing the specific Italian university where the student is enrolled.
participating_institutions: Politecnico di Milano (DSU Lombardia), Politecnico di Torino (EDISU Piemonte), University of Bologna (ER.GO), Sapienza University of Rome (LazioDisco), University of Florence (DSU Toscana), University of Padua (ESU)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 20 universities in Italy; QS World Rankings 100 to 400.
available_majors: All majors (Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Economics, Fashion Design, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Bachelor's: 3 years (180 ECTS); Master's: 2 years (120 ECTS); PhD: 3 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: University pre-admission offer letter, Universitaly pre-enrolment, ISEE Parificato financial documentation.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Admission is granted by the university; the scholarship is granted by the regional government agency. Once admitted to the university, getting the scholarship is practically guaranteed if income documents are certified properly.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus first on securing admission to the Italian university (December - April), then immediately prepare Pakistani family income documents for ISEE Parificato.

application_process_roadmap.submission_portal_url: https://www.edisu.piemonte.it/ (and respective regional portals: dsu.toscana.it, er-go.it, laziodisco.it)
application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Regional Scholarship Portals (EDISU, DSU Toscana, ER.GO, LazioDisco, etc.) & Universitaly Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the respective regional scholarship portal (opens June/July) using passport details, and submit Universitaly pre-enrolment application.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Apply to Italian university during admission calls (December - April) and secure admission letter.
2. Submit pre-enrolment application on official Universitaly portal (universitaly.it).

3. Gather family financial documents in Pakistan: Family Registration Certificate (FRC), Income Certificate (FBR return or employer letter), Property/House documents (Tehsildar certificate), Bank statements.
4. Attest all financial documents from MOFA (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) in Pakistan.
5. Translate all documents into Italian via official Italian Embassy approved translators.
6. Obtain Consular Legalization / Declaration of Value (DOV) or CIMEA comparability certificate.
7. Send documents to Italian Tax Assistance Center (CAF) in Italy to calculate ISEE Parificato certificate.
8. Apply online on the regional scholarship portal (e.g. EDISU / DSU) before late August / early September deadline.
9. Provisional ranking list published (September/October); Final ranking in December.
10. 1st stipend installment and free meal card issued in December/January; 2nd installment in June.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Completely separate: Apply to university admissions first; apply to regional DSU agency for scholarship in summer.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Not required for DSU scholarship (evaluated strictly on financial need index and university admission).
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV used for university admissions.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interview conducted for regional scholarship; 100% paper-based financial qualification.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: None for scholarship; university admission may require TOLC exam or GRE.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: CRITICAL: All family income, property, and civil status documents from Pakistan must be attested by MOFA and translated into Italian.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified Italian translations of all Pakistani documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission on the regional portal, followed by physical presentation of original financial documents upon arrival in Italy.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: Late August to early September annually (strict regional deadlines)
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: Provisional ranking: September/October; Final ranking: December
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: July - September (Italian Embassy Islamabad / Consulate Karachi)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Financial documents must be prepared strictly following Italian consular specifications in Pakistan.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 0% for first-year entry (only university admission required; merit criteria apply for 2nd year renewal)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 100% (Calculated strictly via the official Italian ISEE Parificato formula)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Regional Government Directorate for the Right to University Study (Diritto allo Studio Universitario - DSU).
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Mathematical formula: Applicants with ISEE Parificato < €24,000 are ranked from lowest income to highest; virtually all eligible international students receive scholarship awards.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: Thousands of scholarships per region (entitlement program)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~75% to 85% of eligible applicants who meet financial criteria receive awards
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~80% of Pakistani students with verified ISEE documents receive full funding (Highest Success Rate in Europe)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 2.50 to 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA (Admission to Italian university is the main hurdle)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Secured university admission, perfectly attested Pakistani income and property documents.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani students from all backgrounds and provinces admitted to Politecnico di Milano, Politecnico di Torino, Sapienza, Bologna, Florence, Padua.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Iran, India, Turkey, Lebanon, Egypt.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unregistered agents in Pakistan charging €1,500 to €3,000 claiming they 'grant' Italian scholarships. Regional DSU scholarships are an Italian state right under law.
Fake CAF tax agents forging property documents (automatic Italian visa rejection and police reporting).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: DSU/EDISU application is 100% FREE. Never pay any fee to the regional agency.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Documents must be genuine; the Italian Embassy in Islamabad strictly cross-checks FBR and Tehsildar tax records.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Document translation and consular legalization costs in Pakistan (PKR 30,000 to 70,000).
Italian Embassy student visa appointment and Gerry's fees (~PKR 25,000).

CRITICAL INITIAL CASH BUFFER: The first DSU scholarship installment is paid in late December or January. Students MUST arrive in Italy with sufficient personal funds (€1,500 to €2,500) to cover initial rent deposits and food for the first 3 months!
Italian Permesso di Soggiorno (Residence Permit) card fee (€120) upon arrival.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You get paid before traveling. (Fact: You do NOT receive any money before arriving in Italy; the scholarship is disbursed only after physical university matriculation in Italy).
MYTH: You cannot work in Italy. (Fact: Italian student residence permits allow students to legally work up to 20 hours per week).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Each Italian region (Piedmont, Tuscany, Lombardy, Lazio, Emilia-Romagna) has slightly different ISEE thresholds and deadlines; check the exact regional call (Bando).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must earn minimum university credits (CFU/ECTS) to keep scholarship: typically at least 20 to 35 credits by August 10 of Year 1 to qualify for 2nd year renewal and avoid stipend clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full physical enrollment and attendance in Italy.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Credits automatically verified with university registry.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time student employment permitted up to 20 hours/week (max 1,040 hours/year) under Italian immigration law.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: NO mandatory home return requirement. Graduates can convert their Italian study residence permit to a 1-year Job Seeker Permit (Permesso di Soggiorno per Ricerca Lavoro) or full Work Permit (Lavoro Subordinato).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: CRITICAL WARNING: If a first-year student fails to earn at least 20 credits by August 10, the regional agency DEMANDS FULL REPAYMENT of the cash stipend and charges for meals consumed!
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Permitted only within the same region or upon formal transfer of DSU file.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted once with credit loss implications.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Eligible for extra semester (fuori corso) support of 50% allowance.
